questions.subject: English
questions.stem: Sangeetika Music School is holding an Indo-Western fusion concert next week. Write a notice of about 100 words for the school notice board, giving the occasion, the day it will be held, the musicians with their instruments, and an invitation to attend.

markingPoints.description: Content: states that an Indo-Western fusion concert is being held next week.
Content: names the four musicians with their instruments — Iqbal on the flute, Avinash on the tabla, Peter on the keyboard and Shruti on the violin.
Format: opens with the word NOTICE and sets out the details in short clear lines, as a notice board notice must.
Organisation: the occasion, the musicians and the invitation follow one another in an order a reader can follow at once.
Accuracy and expression: correct spelling and punctuation, a polite and lively style, and a total of about 100 words.

answerScheme.modelAnswer:
NOTICE
Sangeetika Music School

An Indo-Western fusion concert will be held next week. Four young musicians will perform: Iqbal on the flute, Avinash on the tabla, Peter on the keyboard and Shruti on the violin. Their piece builds slowly to a thundering crescendo. They have rehearsed for weeks in Iqbal's room, a room with a small rack and a wooden table stacked with books, whose walls carry posters of Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia and Shashank Subramanyam. All students of the school and their parents are cordially invited to attend and encourage the players.

Principal
